text: At its meeting on June 23, 2022, the Corporations Nominating Panel considered Item NC22.1, Appointment of a Public Member as Chair of the Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation Board and made recommendations to City Council.

City Council on July 19, 20, 21 and 22, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Fareed Amin as Chair of the Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending July 21, 2023, continuing to serve until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1 to 5 to the report (June 14, 2022) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Seniors Housing Corporation Board.
